Justification
1) The project manager coordinates landowners, contractors and the volunteer programme across all three years.
2) The field ecologist carries out the monthly water quality survey and the annual plant and bird counts.
3) Four sondes are needed so that two survey teams can work at the same time on different reaches.
4) The independent evaluation in year 3 is carried out by a university team chosen by open tender.

Risks we have planned for
• Flood events delaying bank works: the contractor schedule leaves a four-week reserve each autumn.
• Loss of volunteers: a paid outreach officer keeps the volunteer register and runs monthly events.
• Invasive species returning: a three-year monitoring plan is built into the ecologist's duties.
